Get involved

Volunteer, partner, or host a drive.

Bring your time, your church or your organization to the work.

Volunteer in Arizona

Help with food, clothing and practical support in the Maricopa community. Tell us what you can offer and when you are free, and the team will talk through current needs with you.

Partner with us

We welcome conversations with churches, shelters, re-entry and recovery programs, hospitals and community organizations, in Arizona and in Benin.

Host a drive

Gather your church, workplace or friends around a food or clothing drive. Talk to the team before you collect, so your drive meets a current need.

Prefer to talk? Call (402) 870-8800
